events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedy legend John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers.

angles.name: Comedy Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: Eighty-seven years young and still making us laugh! Happy birthday to the brilliant John Cleese, a true titan of British comedy. What's your favourite Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1968, The Beatles released their iconic self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album'.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered a masterpiece. The 'White Album' dropped today in '68, a sprawling, genre-bending journey. What's your go-to track from this epic?

events.title: Freddie Mercury would have been 80
events.blurb: Remembering Queen's iconic frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991, and would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost a legend. Today, we pay tribute to the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80. His voice, his showmanship, his legacy endures. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Milestone
angles.copy: A pivotal moment in pop history! Sixty-one years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul', an album that changed everything. Still sounds fresh, doesn't it?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering The Beatles' co-founder John Lennon, who tragically passed away on this day in 1980, and would have been 86 this year.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world lost a visionary. We remember John Lennon, who would have been 86, and his enduring message of peace and love. His music still inspires millions.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Celebrating the life and legacy of the iconic David Bowie, who would have turned 80 today.

angles.name: Bowie's Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Eighty years since a star was born. Today, we're celebrating the extraordinary life and music of David Bowie. What's the Bowie track that means the most to you?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: The King would have been 92 today! Join us in celebrating the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley. What's your favourite Elvis track to get you all shook up?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the absolute guitar genius, Jimmy Page! From The Yardbirds to Led Zeppelin, his riffs are legendary. What's your favourite Pagey moment?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The inimitable Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday, marking decades as a rock and pop icon.

angles.name: Rod The Mod Turns 82
angles.copy: Eighty-two today! Happy birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart. Still got that incredible voice and stage presence after all these years. What's your go-to Rod hit?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham 'Suggs' McPherson, the iconic frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Nutty Boy's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the one and only Suggs from Madness! Still bringing the house down after all these years. What's your favourite Madness tune?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British soul and pop singer Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)', celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Paul Young's 71st
angles.copy: Seventy-one today! Happy birthday to the fantastic Paul Young. Still got that incredible vocal range. What's your favourite Paul Young classic?

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary Queen of Country, Dolly Parton, celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Dolly
angles.copy: Eighty-one and still shining like a rhinestone cowboy! Happy birthday to the iconic Dolly Parton. What's your all-time favourite Dolly song?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and pop icon Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: Barlow's Big Day
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to the one and only Gary Barlow! From Take That anthems to solo ballads, he's given us so many hits. What's your favourite Gary track?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer-songwriter Billy Ocean, known for his string of 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Ocean's 77th
angles.copy: Seventy-seven today! Happy birthday to the smooth voice of Billy Ocean. 'Get Outta My Dreams, Get into My Car' and so many more classics. What's your favourite?

events.title: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame's first induction
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its inaugural induction ceremony, honouring legends like The Beatles, Bob Dylan, and The Rolling Stones.

angles.name: Hall of Fame History
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years ago today, rock history was made! The very first Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony took place, enshrining some true legends. Who do you think should be inducted next?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday.

angles.name: Mark Owen's 55th
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to the charming Mark Owen! From boyband heartthrob to solo artist, he's always entertained. What's your favourite Mark Owen moment?

events.title: The Beatles' iconic rooftop concert anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their legendary final public concert on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London.

angles.name: Rooftop Rock History
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles made history on a London rooftop. Their final public performance – what an iconic way to go out! Imagine being there.

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Grammy-winning musician and Genesis frontman Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday.

angles.name: Phil's 76th
angles.copy: Seventy-six today! Happy birthday to the legendary Phil Collins. From Genesis to his incredible solo career, a true musical powerhouse. What's your favourite Phil track?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: JT's 46th
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From *NSYNC to solo hits, he's done it all. What's your favourite JT track?

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Sir David Jason, known for 'Only Fools and Horses' and 'A Touch of Frost', celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: National Treasure's Birthday
angles.copy: Eighty-seven years young! Happy birthday to the incomparable Sir David Jason, a true national treasure. What's your favourite Del Boy quote or Frost moment?

events.title: The Day The Music Died anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper, who tragically died in a plane crash on this day in 1959, an event known as 'The Day The Music Died'.

angles.name: Remembering The Legends
angles.copy: Sixty-eight years ago today, the music world lost three stars. Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper on 'The Day The Music Died'. Their songs live on.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: British pop icon Rick Astley, famous for 'Never Gonna Give You Up', celebrates his 61st birthday.

angles.name: Rick's 61st
angles.copy: Sixty-one today! Happy birthday to the one and only Rick Astley. Still never gonna give him up! What's your favourite Rick Astley track?

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Celebrating the life and legacy of reggae icon Bob Marley, who would have turned 82 today.

angles.name: Marley's Legacy
angles.copy: Eighty-two years since the birth of a legend. Today, we honour the timeless music and message of Bob Marley. One love, one heart, one incredible artist.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Grammy-winning singer-songwriter Carole King, known for her influential album 'Tapestry', celebrates her 85th birthday.

angles.name: Carole King's 85th
angles.copy: Eighty-five today! Happy birthday to the phenomenal Carole King, a songwriting legend whose 'Tapestry' remains a masterpiece. What's your favourite song she wrote?

events.title: Whitney Houston would have been 64
events.blurb: Remembering the incomparable Whitney Houston, who passed away on this day in 2012, and would have been 64 this year.

angles.name: Remembering Whitney
angles.copy: Fifteen years since we lost one of the greatest voices of all time. Today, we pay tribute to Whitney Houston, who would have been 64. Her music still gives us chills.
